title: MCP Server for AI Document Generation | DocuQueue
excerpt: Document layer for AI agents. Connect Claude, Cursor, and ChatGPT to DocuQueue via MCP.

How It Works

Three steps to AI-powered documents

No setup wizard. No config files to hunt for. Just paste and go.

1

Connect DocuQueue

Sign up, get your API key from the dashboard, and you're ready. Takes about 30 seconds.

2

Add to your AI tool

Paste the MCP config into Claude Desktop, Cursor settings, or any MCP-compatible client.

3

Generate documents

Ask your AI to create documents, fill forms, or manage templates. Natural language, real output.

Features

Everything your AI needs

Full access to your document pipeline, exposed as MCP tools.

Search and browse templates

Find the right template from your library. List all templates, search by name, or filter by type.

Generate documents instantly

Create documents from natural language. Describe what you need, and the AI generates a professional document.

Fill form fields

Populate document forms with structured data. W-9s, W-4s, contracts, and any fillable document.

Batch processing

Generate hundreds of documents in one request. Feed a spreadsheet, get a stack of documents.

What You Can Do

Real documents, real workflows

Not demos. Not placeholders. Production document generation from your AI chat.

Turn any data into a document

Invoices, contracts, proposals, certificates. Any template, any data, instant generation.

Fill IRS forms automatically

W-9, W-4, I-9, 1040 pre-built. AI detects fields, you provide the data, document is ready.

Connect to your workflow

Zapier, Airtable, n8n, Make. Trigger document generation from any automation platform.

Audit every generation

Job logs, credit tracking, webhook callbacks. Full visibility into every document created.

Security

Built for developers who care about security

Your data stays yours. Every layer is designed for trust.

API key authentication

No shared secrets. Each integration gets its own key.

HTTPS everywhere

All data encrypted in transit. No exceptions.

No data storage

Documents generated on-the-fly. Nothing retained after download.

Audit trail

Every API call logged. Full traceability for compliance.

Rate limiting

Abuse prevention built in. Protects your account and usage.

Webhook verification

HMAC signatures for callbacks. Verify every request is authentic.

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

What is MCP?

Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open standard that lets AI assistants like Claude, Cursor, and ChatGPT connect to external tools and data sources. Think of it as a universal plugin system for AI.

Which AI tools support MCP?

Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, ChatGPT, Gemini, and any MCP-compatible client. One server works across all of them.

Do I need to install anything?

No local installation required. Just add the DocuQueue MCP server URL to your AI client's config. Takes under a minute.

Is my data secure?

Yes. All communication is encrypted over HTTPS. We use API key authentication. Documents are generated on-the-fly and not stored indefinitely. Every API call is logged for audit purposes.

How much does it cost?

The MCP server is free to use. You pay per document generated (1 credit per document). Start saving time on document creation immediately. See pricing for details.

Can I generate documents in bulk?

Yes. Use the batch generation endpoint to create hundreds of documents in a single request. Perfect for invoices, contracts, or any high-volume document workflow.

FAQ

常见问题

什么是MCP？

模型上下文协议 (MCP) 是一种开放标准，可让 Claude、Cursor 和 ChatGPT 等 AI 助手连接到外部工具和数据源。 将其视为人工智能的通用插件系统。

哪些AI工具支持MCP？

Claude Desktop、Cursor、Windsurf、ChatGPT、Gemini 以及任何 MCP 兼容客户端。 一台服务器可以跨所有这些服务器工作。

我需要安装什么东西吗？

无需本地安装。 只需将 DocuQueue MCP 服务器 URL 添加到 AI 客户端的配置中即可。 需要不到一分钟。

我的数据安全吗？

是的。 所有通信均通过 HTTPS 加密。 我们使用 API 密钥身份验证。 文档是即时生成的，不会无限期存储。 每个 API 调用都会被记录下来以供审计之用。

它要多少钱？

MCP 服务器可免费使用。 您按生成的文档付费（每个文档 1 个积分）。 立即开始节省文档创建时间。 详情请参阅定价。

可以批量生成文档吗？

是的。 使用批量生成端点在单个请求中创建数百个文档。 非常适合发票、合同或任何大容量文档工作流程。
